title: PM-KISAN
summary_en: Income support paid directly to the bank accounts of eligible landholding farmer families.

eligibility.other: Landholding farmer families, subject to the exclusions in the scheme guidelines.

benefit: Direct income support paid in instalments to bank accounts.
how_to_apply: Register on the PM-KISAN portal or at a Common Service Centre with Aadhaar, land records and bank details.

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
summary_en: Health cover for hospital treatment for eligible poor and vulnerable families.

eligibility.other: Families identified through SECC data and other notified categories.

benefit: Cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility on the official portal or at the Ayushman Mitra desk of an empanelled hospital.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Ministry of Rural Development
summary_en: Help for eligible households without a pucca house to build or buy one.

eligibility.other: Eligible households without a pucca house, per the rural and urban guidelines.

benefit: Financial assistance for a house.
how_to_apply: Apply through the PMAY portal, your urban local body or gram panchayat.

title: PM Ujjwala Yojana
authority: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
summary_en: LPG connection support for women from eligible poor households.

eligibility.other: Adult women from eligible households without an LPG connection.

benefit: Support for a new LPG connection.
how_to_apply: Apply at an LPG distributor or on the official portal with KYC documents.

title: Atal Pension Yojana
authority: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
summary_en: A voluntary pension scheme for workers, especially in the unorganised sector.

eligibility.other: Needs a savings bank account.

benefit: A fixed monthly pension after age 60, depending on the contribution chosen.
how_to_apply: Enrol at your bank or through net banking.

title: e-Shram registration
summary_en: National database registration for unorganised workers, giving access to social security benefits.

eligibility.other: Not a member of EPFO or ESIC and not an income-tax payer.

benefit: A registration card and access to social security schemes.
how_to_apply: Register on the e-Shram portal or at a Common Service Centre with Aadhaar and a bank account.

title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
summary_en: Monthly pension support for older people from poor households.

eligibility.other: Below-poverty-line households, as per NSAP guidelines.

benefit: A monthly pension from central and state governments.
how_to_apply: Apply through your gram panchayat, municipality or district social welfare office.

title: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
summary_en: Collateral-free loans for small and micro businesses.

eligibility.other: Non-farm small business activity.

benefit: Loans in categories for starting and growing small businesses.
how_to_apply: Apply at a bank, NBFC or microfinance institution or on the Udyamimitra portal.

title: Stand-Up India
summary_en: Bank loans for women and SC/ST entrepreneurs starting a new enterprise.

eligibility.other: SC/ST or women entrepreneurs setting up a first-time enterprise.

benefit: Bank loans for a new enterprise.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Stand-Up India portal or a bank branch.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
authority: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
summary_en: Short-term skill training for young people with a certificate at the end.

eligibility.other: Indian nationals looking for skill training; course conditions vary.

benefit: Free skill training and a certificate.
how_to_apply: Find a training centre on the Skill India portal.

title: Post Matric Scholarships (National Scholarship Portal)
authority: Ministry of Social Justice, Tribal Affairs and Minority Affairs
summary_en: Financial support for post-matric studies for students from notified categories.

eligibility.other: Family income limits and course conditions are set by each scheme.

benefit: Financial support for post-matric education.
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal with income, caste and marks documents.

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
summary_en: Support for girl students in AICTE-approved technical programmes.

eligibility.other: Admitted to an AICTE-approved technical programme; family income limit applies.

benefit: Financial assistance for tuition and expenses.
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal.

title: Scholarships for Students with Disabilities
authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
summary_en: Scholarships for students with disabilities at various education levels.

eligibility.other: Disability certificate and course conditions apply.

benefit: Financial support for education.
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal.

title: Kanyashree Prakalpa
summary_en: A conditional cash transfer scheme to keep girls in school and delay early marriage.

eligibility.other: Girl students enrolled in school or college, as per scheme rules.

benefit: Annual and one-time cash benefits.
how_to_apply: Apply through your school or college, or the Kanyashree portal.

title: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana
summary_en: Financial support for girls at different stages of education.

eligibility.other: Girls from Bihar, as per scheme rules.

benefit: Financial support linked to education milestones.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Bihar education department portal.

title: Pudhumai Penn
summary_en: Monthly support for girl students from government schools who go on to higher education.

eligibility.other: Girls who studied in government schools, as per scheme rules.

benefit: Monthly financial support during higher education.
how_to_apply: Apply through your college as per the state notification.

title: KALIA Scheme
summary_en: Support for small and marginal farmers and landless agricultural households in Odisha.

eligibility.other: Small and marginal farmers and landless agricultural households.

benefit: Financial assistance for cultivation and livelihood.
how_to_apply: Check the state agriculture department for the current application process.

title: UPSC Civil Services Examination
summary_en: The exam for the IAS, IPS, IFS and other central services.

eligibility.other: Age and attempt limits are fixed in each year's notification.

benefit: Recruitment to the All India and Central Services.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the UPSC website when the notification is released.

title: SSC Combined Graduate Level
summary_en: A graduate-level exam for Group B and C posts in central government departments.

eligibility.other: Post-wise age and qualification criteria apply.

benefit: Group B and C posts in central departments.
how_to_apply: Register and apply online on the SSC website.

title: NEET (UG)
summary_en: The entrance exam for MBBS, BDS and other undergraduate medical courses.

eligibility.other: Details are in the NTA information bulletin.

benefit: Admission to undergraduate medical courses.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the NTA NEET portal.

title: JEE Main
summary_en: The entrance exam for NITs, IIITs and other engineering institutes; qualifies for JEE Advanced.

eligibility.other: Details are in the NTA information bulletin.

benefit: Admission to engineering institutes.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the NTA JEE Main portal.

title: GATE
summary_en: The exam for M.Tech and PhD admission and some PSU recruitment in engineering and science.

eligibility.other: Final-year students can usually apply; see the brochure.

benefit: Admission to postgraduate programmes and some PSU recruitment.
how_to_apply: Register on the official GATE application portal.

title: IBPS Common Recruitment Process for Banks
summary_en: Exams for officer and clerk recruitment in public sector banks.

eligibility.other: Post-wise criteria apply.

benefit: Recruitment to public sector banks.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the IBPS website when a notification is open.

title: Railway Recruitment Board vacancies
summary_en: Central railway recruitment through the Railway Recruitment Boards.

eligibility.other: Eligibility differs by post; see each notification.

benefit: Posts in Indian Railways.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the regional RRB website named in the notification.

title: Employment News listings
summary_en: Weekly listings of government vacancies and exams.

eligibility.other: Each advertised post has its own criteria.

benefit: Information about government jobs and exams.
how_to_apply: Read the listing and apply through the advertising department's official site.
